title: Console batch: a Ctrl-C before a repository's commit runs leaves Commit to choose again
summary: In the console's batch screen, a Ctrl-C during the Commit, or Commit, push and open PRs, choice leaves each repository whose `git commit` had not started, including one whose `git add` was running, reading `not committed: stopped`; while any does, the same choice is offered again instead of leaving the next list, so those commits can still be made. A repository whose `git commit` was running when the Ctrl-C came still reads failed.
